stock.description: Zoomlion Heavy Industry Science and Technology Co., Ltd., along with its various affiliates, operates globally, focusing on the innovation, production, and distribution of heavy equipment for both construction and agriculture. The company organizes its operations into three main divisions: Construction Equipment, Agricultural Equipment, and Financial Services. Within its Construction Equipment segment, Zoomlion offers an extensive portfolio of machinery. This includes a wide array of concrete handling solutions such as truck-mounted and trailer-mounted pumps, mixing plants, and concrete mixers. They also manufacture diverse crane types, including truck, all-terrain, crawler, and various tower cranes. Furthermore, their offerings span road construction and maintenance equipment, pile driving machinery, earthmoving apparatus, material handling systems, specialized vehicles, and vehicle axles. Forklift trucks and other vital products for infrastructure and property development are also part of their production. For the agricultural sector, the company provides essential machinery like tractors, grain harvesting equipment, and drying machines. Beyond manufacturing, Zoomlion delivers comprehensive financial services, including equipment leasing, commercial lending via factoring, and bond issuance. Its activities also extend to leasing and trading equipment, developing machine software and hydraulic components, researching motor vehicle parts, and even managing tourism assets. Established in 1992 in Changsha, People's Republic of China, the company adopted its current name, Zoomlion Heavy Industry Science and Technology Co., Ltd., in October 2011, having previously been known as Changsha Zoomlion Heavy Industry Science and Technology Development Co., Ltd.
